title: Closure under majority repetition
statement: For every Boolean predicate $M$ and natural numbers $a,k,a',k'$, if the verifier that returns $M(x,r)$ is efficient in the model, then so is the verifier that returns true when more than half of the first $a'(|x|+1)^{k'}$ consecutive blocks of $r$, each of length $a(|x|+1)^k$, make $M$ return true.
hypotheses_covered: The verifier associated to $M$ is efficient
